title: Understanding Response Bias
text: Think about what response bias means. It's related to how the responses you get might not accurately reflect the true preferences of the entire group you're studying. Consider how increasing the sample size or sending reminders might affect this bias.

title: Impact of Sample Size
text: Increasing the sample size from $$100$$ to $$200$$ could potentially give you more responses, but does it necessarily change the nature of the responses you get? Consider if the bias is about the number of responses or the type of responses.

title: Effect of Reminder Emails
text: Sending a reminder email might encourage more students to respond. Think about whether this affects the bias in the responses or just the number of responses.

title: Evaluating Changes in Response Bias
text: Consider the changes suggested: increasing the sample size and sending reminders. How do these changes affect the likelihood of response bias?
